## Description and Rationale

I am an independent data and AI professional from Chile.

I decided to join the PRC Data Challenge mainly because I want to learn, improve my machine-learning skills, and work with a real-world aviation dataset.

I am especially interested in exploring the data, testing different approaches, and understanding which factors have the biggest impact on taxi-out time prediction.

My goal is to build a simple, reproducible solution, learn from the process, and enjoy the challenge.
